definitions.explanation: Official recognition or guarantee from an authority. Originally referred to documents bearing an official seal in feudal Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墨付|すみつ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got the doctor's seal of approval.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墨付|すみつ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a product endorsed by experts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墨付|すみつ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: The project was approved with the president's endorsement.

notes:
お{墨付|すみつ}き conveys the idea of authoritative endorsement — approval from someone whose opinion carries weight. It adds a sense of trustworthiness or credibility.

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally referred to documents bearing an official black ink (⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧) seal or signature from feudal lords or the shogunate. The お prefix adds politeness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墨付|すみつ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to get approval/endorsement from ~
- お{墨付|すみつ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give one's seal of approval
- お{墨付|すみつ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have official approval
- お{墨付|すみつ}き⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: endorsed, with official approval

USAGE:
Often used with authority figures: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墨付|すみつ}き (doctor's approval), ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墨付|すみつ}き (expert endorsement), ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墨付|すみつ}き (president's approval). Can be used somewhat humorously or ironically.
